title: Reject proposals with both Tool and Skill targets
goal: Fail closed during structural verification when one action proposal declares both a Tool target and a Skill target.
context: M6 execution dispatch prioritizes skillID and returns before the tool path. DefaultVerifier currently accepts a proposal that contains both IDs, so policy and audit metadata can describe two targets while only one executes.
forbidden_changes: Do not reject answer-only proposals with neither target.
Do not change valid Tool-only or Skill-only proposal behavior.
Do not attempt either execution path for an ambiguous proposal.
acceptance_criteria: DefaultVerifier rejects proposals with both toolID and skillID.
The goal aborts with a verification failure before action execution.
No actionExecuted event is emitted for either target.
Regression covers the exact ambiguous proposal.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Add a structural verifier guard for mutually exclusive target IDs and assert no execution event occurs.
